meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务拆成超细粒度、绑定证据的步骤:先按参考文件登记目标与验收标准,再把每一步同步进实时清单,进度存进 .omo/ulw-loop 状态,上下文丢失后能凭状态续跑,代码与测试交给子代理执行。
howto.when: 当你提出 ulw-loop、ulw 等关键词,或要求持久化、带检查点的长时目标执行时,它按流程接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 跑这个目标,每一步都要有可验证的证据。
say.note: 会先登记目标再逐步执行

say.text: 看下 ulw-loop 的状态和清单,接着上次的进度继续。
say.note: 读取状态后从检查点恢复

say.text: 把这个任务拆成超细步骤,逐条更新清单并记录检查点。

howto.what_en: Claude splits work into ultra-granular, evidence-bound steps, registers the goal and success criteria first, mirrors each step into a live checklist, and keeps resumable state under .omo/ulw-loop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop or ulw, or want durable, checkpointed long-running goal execution.

say_en.text: Run this goal with ulw-loop, with verifiable evidence for every step.
say_en.note: Registers the goal, then executes step by step

say_en.text: Check ulw-loop status and checklist, then resume from the last checkpoint.
Break this into ultra-granular steps and record checkpoints as you go.
